release_notes:
v1.1.2 Release - Group Calculations Unit & Log Formatting Updates.

Changes:
  - Calculations Unit Inheritance: Dynamically resolves and inherits unit configurations for statistics from matching variable group signals when not explicitly specified.
  - Prefixless Calculations Logging: Logged calculation Excel headers are now prefixless (e.g., 'Cell Voltages min (V)' instead of '0x0100.Cells avg (V)') for clean data reporting.
  - Layout Restoration Fix: Resolved a bug where restoring layouts containing calculations (using 'calc' keys) crashed the GUI settings loader.
